statement: First independent scan-only inventory of the f89r2 portion of canvas 1006233. No other f89r2 annotation or transcription words were read. Full-spread context, a direct panel crop and top/bottom details were inspected. Neighboring 88v and f89r1 excluded. Four vessels and sixteen provisional plant/root drawing units are recorded. Fragment counts follow visible connections and are not forced to match label counts. The faint lower-fold unit and several crossings remain uncertain; this is not a claim of sixteen securely distinct botanical specimens.

label_mapping.basis: Only the verified ZL locus IDs and types were extracted. Blocks are Lc .1 then four Lf .2–.5 and paragraph .6–.8; Lc .9 then Lf .10–.11 and paragraph .12–.15; Lc .16 then Lf .17–.21 and paragraph .22–.28; Lc .29,+Lc .30 then Lf .31–.34.
label_mapping.vessels: The four unique left-margin vessels occupy these four horizontal blocks in the same top-to-bottom order. Assign .1, .9, .16 and .29 structurally, without matching glyph strings. The bottom caption occupies two lines; .30 is retained as an additional associated locus, while the schema label field uses .29.
label_mapping.fragments: All individual fragment labels stay null: non-specific @Lf locators and sequence numbers do not give a secure coordinate key. Third-row inventory has six provisional visible units although there are five Lf loci; some units may be unlabelled or merged, and this discrepancy is not resolved by guessing label identities.

provenance.coordinates: Approximate [x,y] centres on the displayed 1600-wide panel crop, height 1558. Origin top-left. Native x=5200+x*3878/1600; native y=y*3878/1600. Free position features are not scored vocabulary.
provenance.ordering: Four vessels, then drawing units in visual rows top-to-bottom and left-to-right. IDs are local object identifiers, not ZL numbers.
provenance.limits: One reader. Species identities and word meanings not inferred. A lower-fold form may be an offset or fragment; it is retained with unclear colour and explicit provisional status rather than silently certified. Root crossings and some connected-unit boundaries are uncertain. Caption-to-vessel assignments are structural inferences, not independently confirmed word alignments.

features.shape: Uppermost vessel: narrow elongated neck, broad body with alternating red and green horizontal bands, pale decorated collar and spreading foot.
Second vessel: lidded pale body with long vertical red stripes, green neck bands and green branched foot.
Third vessel: compound pale vessel with rounded stacked sections, thin red bands, green stem segments and a green splayed foot.
Bottom vessel: bulbous oval body with curved alternating red and green stripes, green stem sections and a wide pale ochre foot. Two-line caption beside the body.
Red-brown elongated root fragment splitting into several pointed lower branches, with a few pale/green upright stalks.
Bundle of thin pale upright stalks above several descending red-brown roots; no securely filled blade identified.

Complex connected drawing with paired rounded toothed green blades, a larger lobed green upper mass, pale upright stems and a large tan bulb with long curved root extensions. Exact extent at the crease uncertain.
Long bent ochre root/stem, pale spreading upright branches and a large elongated green blade toward the far right; tapered curved root descends at the edge.
Large green deeply lobed left blade linked by pale stems to a tan knotted root and a long open cage-like network of ochre roots with a darker oval interior.
Two green lobed blades to the left of a small pale oval body with fine long curving root lines extending right. Boundaries near the fold and neighboring root are faint.
Several curved green leaflets on pale stalks above an ochre bulbous root with a pale slit and a few long forked extensions.
Three small green blades along one upright stem, attached to a bent red-brown lobed root.
One small rounded green blade on a branching stem above a pale ochre root tuft with several pointed strands.
Star-like lobed green blade and pale curved stalks above a red-brown root with several long descending branches.
Single narrow toothed horizontal green blade above a thin stem and a pale bent root with several long parallel curved strands.

Large red-brown oval root with many long thick reddish branches running down and right; two pale stalks reach a rounded ragged green head and a narrow green upper blade. Kept separate from the neighboring thin-root fragment.
Rounded green blade with a pale curved division above a thick short pink-red root bending downward; small detached reddish dash nearby not a separate plant.
Horizontal dark-green serrated oblong fragment with a thin pale rightward stem ending in a faint reddish attachment. Exact boundary near the damaged crease uncertain.

Faint green lobed form near the damaged fold with a long thin curved brown outline descending toward the bottom. Separation from its neighbors is provisional; possible offset or incompletely visible fragment.
Rounded toothed green blade on a pale stalk attached to a very large ochre root system, with thick descending branches partly cut off by the page edge and faint upright shoots.
